fieldValues.title: An agent cannot tell whether the memory it reads is current
fieldValues.statement: An agent reading srs-context has no way to know whether a record still holds. Its copy can be behind origin without notice (a stray write left the main clone dirty, so the session hook stopped fast-forwarding and served a brief 16 commits old), and a record's last_verified says only when someone last re-read it, not whether the code it points at has changed since. So the agent either trusts the memory blindly or re-reads the source, and the memory saves nothing.
source_ref: srs-context hooks/session-start.sh: fast-forwards only a clean main
srs-context bench/staleness.mjs: staleness is age in days, not change since verification
